entities.title: macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64/aarch64 only
entities.summary: The invoker has syscall backends for those three targets; any other fails to compile.
entities.impact: There is no zazzle for Intel Macs or other systems.
entities.workaround: Use `zazzled mcp`, `zazzled run`, `zazzled wrap` or `zazzled proxy`, which need no invoker.

entities.title: Command lines up to 256 KiB
entities.summary: The session and all arguments, each with its NUL, must fit a 256 KiB request buffer.
entities.impact: A longer command line exits 64 with `arguments too long`.
entities.workaround: Pass a long --new text on standard input with `--new -`.

entities.title: Short socket paths only
entities.summary: The socket path must fit a unix socket address: 103 bytes on macOS, 107 on Linux.
entities.impact: A longer ZAZZLE_SOCK, or a deep HOME, exits 78 with `socket path too long`.
entities.workaround: Point ZAZZLE_SOCK at a shorter path.

entities.title: Standalone tools only from beside the invoker
entities.summary: `zazzle free-disk-space` and `zazzle fix-network` run the binary of that exact name in the invoker's own directory; PATH and ZAZZLE_DAEMON are not consulted. Only the invoker run as zazzle does this; as zazz or a shim those words are arguments to a zazz request.
entities.impact: If the tool is installed elsewhere, the subcommand fails with `cannot run the tool (error N)`, exit 69.
entities.workaround: Run the tool directly, or install it beside zazzle (the release tarballs and the formula do).
